items.title: Wrought Iron Vine Gate DXF Design with Vertical Bars
items.description: Vertical bars run the full height of the panel, entwined with classic wrought-iron scrollwork, leaf curls, and a pair of ring medallions. This traditional forged-metal look is ideal for security gates, railings, and entry doors.

items.title: Circular Diamond Cross DXF Lattice for Balanced Modern Screens
items.description: Rounded arcs interlock into a grid of diamonds and crosses, giving a soft yet structured geometric rhythm across the panel. The balanced circular-diamond motif suits modern gates, stair infill, and screens wanting understated elegance.

items.title: Symmetrical S-Curve Baroque Scroll Accent Divider
items.description: An elegant vertical screen showcasing dramatic, mirrored S-curve scrolls and flowing acanthus foliage. The design features heavy organic curls at the upper left and lower right corners, creating a fluid, diagonal balance across a solid field.
